None of the five lies under an installed subtree. All three installed skills were compared in BOTH directions at both pins via `git rev-parse <sha>:skills/<dir>`: skill-creator, frontend-design and webapp-testing have identical subtree SHAs (3cf9a8db, 0d5b74a1, 5ffb7dc6) to the prior pin -- vendored bytes changed: 0, independently confirming PR #188's claim; the trigger and authority surface of every installed skill is untouched and no behavioural eval was required (EVAL_REQUIRED not applicable). scripts_audited is CARRIED FORWARD on demonstrated byte identity to the already-audited bytes, NOT re-established. "Provenance only" describes the UPSTREAM side: no upstream byte this project vendors changed. Two new sibling skills were read end to end at the target commit and both recorded EXCLUDE, closing the DISCOVERY_REQUIRED review for Issue #187: (1) academy-guide -- confirmed by live upstream evidence, not assumed, to be the renamed successor of claude-academy-guide: commit 0a64e39's own message ('Rename claude-academy-guide skill to academy-guide and shorten its description (#1605)') is the rename, LICENSE.txt is byte-identical and SKILL.md is an 88%-similarity rename carrying the same purpose, trigger, and Apache-2.0 terms.
